create_NVFP4QuantLinear: create an NVFP4QuantLinear layer with given in_features, out_features, and QuantizationScheme config
from_original_NVFP4QuantLinear: create an NVFP4QuantLinear layer from an existing torch.nn.Linear layer using from_original
dequant_weight_online_NVFP4QuantLinear: dequantize the packed NVFP4 weight tensor back to full precision using dequant_weight_online
qdq_input_NVFP4QuantLinear: quantize and dequantize an input activation tensor using the qdq_input method
forward_NVFP4QuantLinear: run a forward pass through the NVFP4QuantLinear layer with quantized input and dequantized weight
